mechanism.design: Independent telemetry-sampler and kernel-state-changer OS processes. A blocked select/acknowledgement cannot suspend the sampler process.
mechanism.duration_margin: Sampler continues through the requested window plus selector timeout and two telemetry periods so the sample timeline covers at least 5400 seconds and includes the final in-flight state change.
mechanism.invalid_or_slow_telemetry: Fails closed at bounded subprocess timeout and preserves any returned raw sample before contract rejection.
mechanism.kernel_coverage: All 28 kernel ids must be selected and observed before soak PASS.
mechanism.sample_logging: Each raw returned telemetry response is appended and fsynced before validation; no per-sample progress sidecar write blocks the sampler.

mutation_authority: seq43 candidate / seq44 genuine failure recovery only; no transaction started by this offline proof
other_offline_checks: seq43 dry-run binds exact candidate/recovery artifacts, inherited seq39 sweep/baseline/frozen policy, and performs no network/device mutation
soak audit and threshold/evidence tooling tests PASS

regression.assertion: No sampler gap over 5s while selector remained blocked for 24.114s; production soak enforces <=15s.
regression.parallel_ready_signal: PARALLEL_LANES_READY emitted after three persisted, contract-valid samples; regression asserts status and sample hash
